# combine mkdir and cd

Add a helper that creates a directory and enters it in one step — the `mkdir foo && cd foo` pair every shell user types — following the [unix.stackexchange answers on combining mkdir and cd](https://unix.stackexchange.com/questions/125385/combined-mkdir-and-cd). The body of the issue is only that link.

The expected behaviour is a function (it must change the caller's directory, so a script cannot do it) that takes a path, creates it with `mkdir -p` so that nested and existing directories are fine, and `cd`s into it; without an argument it should explain itself rather than create something odd.
